Package org.example.dao

Class SimulationRunDAO

java.lang.Object
org.example.dao.SimulationRunDAO
public class SimulationRunDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for performing CRUD operations on the simulation_runs database table in MariaDB.

Handles the persistence and retrieval of overall simulation run performance summary metrics, including total customer counts, service durations, customer breakdown by type, and station utilization rates.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Daniel

      public List<SimulationRun> getAllRuns()
